name: Forest Lord Cenarius
guide_text: Always hero power the first 3 turns, freezing a 2 cost spell turn 1 if you can. Turn 4 onwards, you can choose to stop hero powering if buying a good minion or dark gifting is better. Definitely stop hero powering after turn 5.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy for at most 3 gold. Must reborn it with [[Sprightly Scarab||108909]].
